criteria.requirement: Maya Chen has six complete local posts about cities, food and everyday experiments, with reading-first typography.
criteria.action: Read the post list and open all six sample articles.
criteria.expected: Maya Chen's six complete local posts cover cities, food and everyday experiments with readable typography.

criteria.requirement: A small genuinely interactive 3D desk adds personality without obstructing or delaying article access.
criteria.action: Use the offered desk interaction, then immediately open a post.
criteria.expected: A genuinely interactive 3D desk adds personality while article access remains unobstructed.

criteria.requirement: Topic filtering updates posts and article views provide full readable content.
criteria.action: Change topic filters and open matching articles.
criteria.expected: Filters update the list and article views contain full readable content.

criteria.requirement: Article URLs are shareable and survive refresh; browser back returns coherent reading/list context.
criteria.action: Open an article URL directly, refresh it and use browser back.
criteria.expected: The URL restores the same article and back returns coherent reading/list context.

criteria.requirement: Keyboard access, narrow-screen reading and reduced-motion behavior preserve usable content.
criteria.action: Navigate by keyboard, inspect phone reading and enable reduced motion.
criteria.expected: Content remains usable with keyboard, narrow layouts and reduced-motion preferences.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the blog and desk while confirming immediate access to posts.
Filter by topic, open and read a full article, and use offered desk interactions.
Refresh an article URL, use browser back, inspect keyboard focus and mobile reading; do not require an unrequested writing backend.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
